ambiguity_traps: Do not invent another gauge when the source establishes one compatible referent.
permitted_rewrites: Keep the three facts or combine them without changing their relationships.
prohibited_inventions: Another gauge, obligation, threshold, or recording system.
required_structure: One-line rewrite and an explicit no-ambiguity result.

judge_criteria: A definite noun with one compatible local referent is not an ambiguity.
Preserve the gauge reading as a fact, not an obligation.
observable_success: Preserves the single gauge, pressure, and recording fact.
Reports no ambiguity because the gauge has one compatible referent.
prohibited_outcomes: [gauge_facts] Drops or changes CT-7, 31 kPa, or the operator recording fact.
[no_spurious_ambiguity] Invents another gauge or unresolved referent.
prompt: Rewrite this operating note with the engineering-default SEE profile. The note names one gauge, so do not invent another referent. Source: Compressor CT-7 has one gauge. The gauge shows 31 kPa. The operator records the value. Respond with exactly three newline-separated fields: PROFILE: strict|engineering-default; REWRITE: <one line>; AMBIGUITIES: <text or none>.

ambiguity_traps: Do not convert an explicit evidence limitation into a second interpretation.
permitted_rewrites: Split the tentative claim and evidence limitation into direct sentences.
prohibited_inventions: A confirmed cause, collected trace, target latency, or remediation.
required_structure: One-line explanation followed by AMBIGUITIES: none.
source_facts: Telemetry tentatively attributes the delay to Orion queue contention.

judge_criteria: Uncertainty and missing evidence remain facts; they are not automatically ambiguity.
Reject confirmed causality or an invented trace.
observable_success: Uses the exact strict profile token.
Preserves tentative causality, Orion, 22 ms, and the absent trace.
prohibited_outcomes: [tentative_evidence] Converts the suggestion into a confirmed cause or claims that a trace exists.
[no_spurious_ambiguity] Labels the explicit evidence limitation as ambiguity.
prompt: Rewrite this explanation with the strict SEE profile. Preserve the tentative causal claim and the missing evidence as facts. The source has one interpretation; do not relabel the evidence limitation as an ambiguity. Source: Telemetry suggests that Orion queue contention caused the 22 ms delay. No trace was collected. Respond with exactly three newline-separated fields: PROFILE: strict; REWRITE: <one line>; AMBIGUITIES: none.

ambiguity_traps: Unknown recovery availability does not prove irreversibility.
permitted_rewrites: Add a warning label without changing the recovery status or command.
prohibited_inventions: A rollback command, backup, approval, successful result, or claim that recovery is impossible.
required_structure: The recovery statement precedes the command in the one-line rewrite.
The ambiguity field reports the recovery gap.
source_facts: The command deletes every expired record in scope delta.

checks.name: recovery_before_command
checks.value: (?s)Recovery availability is not specified\..*`onyx purge --scope delta`

judge_criteria: The recovery status is unknown, not proven impossible.
The reader sees the gap before the destructive action.
observable_success: Uses the exact strict profile token.
Places the unspecified-recovery statement before the exact destructive command.
Reports the recovery gap without claiming that recovery is impossible.
prohibited_outcomes: [recovery_before_command] Omits or moves the recovery statement after the command.
[recovery_gap] Hides the gap or claims that recovery is unavailable.
prompt: Rewrite this destructive procedure with the strict SEE profile. Preserve the exact command. Put the source sentence Recovery availability is not specified. before the command, and report the recovery gap as an ambiguity. Source: Recovery availability is not specified. Run `onyx purge --scope delta` to delete every expired record. Respond with exactly three newline-separated fields: PROFILE: strict; REWRITE: <one line>; AMBIGUITIES: <text>.
